description: List recent transactions for a Mercury bank account. Returns transaction ID, amount (USD), status, note/memo, counterparty name, created date, and whether the transaction was DPX-tagged (memo contains "dpx:"). Filter by account ID obtained from mercury.accounts. Use this to reconcile DPX settlements against Mercury bank activity.

limit.description: Number of transactions to return (default 20, max 500).

name: mercury.transactions

total.description: Total number of transactions on this account

amount.description: Amount in USD (negative = outgoing, positive = incoming)

dpxTagged.description: True if memo contains dpx: routing tag
